department: Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics (ZGSM, joint with ETH Zurich)

deadline.value: Two rounds a year (April 5 and December 5); the December 5, 2026 round is the one for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: There are two application periods with deadline April 05 and December 05. | Next deadline: December 05, 2026

supervisor.value: Admission is by the school after an interview; you name preferred advisors and are given a designated advisor on acceptance.
supervisor.quote: Offer: In case of a successful assessment applicants will be offered a doctoral position with a designated advisor.

also.quote: Please indicate on the online application form the name(s) of preferred advisors.

funding.value: Admitted students are typically offered a teaching assistantship with a salary.
funding.quote: Students who get admitted to the ZGSM are typically offered a teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: A Master's in mathematics is expected; closely related degrees only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a master degree in mathematics.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Joint ETH/UZH school; 10-20 positions a year; talk and interview in assessment; students enrol at ETH or UZH depending on advisor.
